messages:
devon: Heads up — acme-corp reports /v1/rerank started failing after they upgraded our SDK. Getting 410 with code MODEL_DEPRECATED and scores are all zeros. Request id: rq_0a1b2c3d

maria: Thanks. Can you paste the minimal repro (model id + request-id)?

devon: Minimal repro:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-legacy-2021","query":"best hotels in sf","candidates": ["A","B","C"]}'
```
Response body:
```json
{"error":"MODEL_DEPRECATED","code":410,"message":"model rerank-legacy-2021 is deprecated"}
```
Request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d

tyler: I can see the request in infra logs. Model rerank-legacy-2021 had a deprecation flag set (epoch 1938700000). We normally rely on alias redirects but the customer is calling the concrete model id (pinned) so they hit the deprecation path.

maria: Do they use our JS/py SDKs? Older SDKs sometimes hardcode defaults. If so they need to update to use rerank-v2 or switch to an alias like "rerank/latest".

sara: Product added the deprecation after offline quality checks. We created alias "rerank/latest" -> "rerank-v2", but did not create a global redirect for every legacy id. Migration was expected.

devon: Customer says they have a release freeze and can't flip the model id immediately. Can we enable a temporary redirect for their tenant?

product-ops: We can do a tenant-scoped alias mapping. I'll open a change to add a temporary redirect for acme-corp from rerank-legacy-2021 -> rerank-v2 (48h).

support-bot: Change request cr_789 opened by product-ops. ETA ~30m. :gear:

tyler: Pushed tenant alias mapping: "acme-corp:rerank-legacy-2021" -> "rerank-v2". Verified in routing table and model metadata service.

devon: Confirmed with acme-corp — rerank now returns expected scores (non-zero). They patched staging and will roll prod tomorrow. Closing on our side. :tada:

maria: Follow-up: we should add a metric/alert for calls that hit deprecated-model path so we can proactively notify customers. Filing a ticket.

product-ops: Agreed — adding a step to the model-deprecation runbook and rollout checklist.
